text:
Completed controlled calibration and installed the reproducible research tools, regression fixtures, reviewed plots and report. No new production default or inference API was added.

Report: docs/verification/group-controls-2026-09-08.md. Receipt: docs/verification/group-controls-2026-09-08.json.gz, 2,848,103 bytes, SHA256 3dbe86486236827217be003897f5ef3599ff2dc096a7996b05823c3e2da1b4dc. Tools: tools/group-calibration-controls.

642,000 independent studies: 82,000 pilot, 80,000 fresh confirmation, 240,000 estimated-SE and 240,000 fresh feasible-weighting. Paired power/coverage calculations and replays are not counted again. Native PM/mKH reaches 8.85% false positives in the n=80, reversed-variance, tau=0, first-level df=8 cell (95% CI 8.30-9.42%). Independent metafor agrees. Equal-subject HC3 normal/skew confirmation is 3.94%/8.90%. Feasible inverse-vhat HC3 spans 1.98-4.78% across 24 Gaussian cells; equal-subject HC3 spans 3.12-4.95% and sometimes has materially more power (71.54% versus 55.78%). No universal admission follows.

Validation: eight numerical tests pass; 152 explicit independent R fixtures (8 bootstrap/covariance, 72 native PM/privileged-weighting, 72 feasible HC3); 72 fresh native public-API fixture executions; full 24-cell estimated-stage input-hash/count/finite audit. Rebuilt 18 current native group sources; smoke results exactly reproduce the historical native outputs. Clean receipt extraction reran three R scripts, eight tests and evidence verification successfully. Verified 113 installed file hashes and 18 native group source hashes. No production source edit this slice, and no fresh whole-library JVM/JS, performance, app-adoption or release claim.

Visual evidence: 15 artifact records include original PNGs, SVGs and inspected SVG renders. Fixed overlapping titles/subtitles, an overly broad headline, omitted power uncertainty and insufficient non-color distinctions. Retained superseded artifacts and exact hashes. Static review is by the implementer, not an independent UI milestone review. Four earlier calibration receipt hashes are unchanged.

General admission bd-01M20TKX7VYFT3BHCM7QAMA6NG and uncertainty provenance bd-01M210WJ4BWVCXEMTARHDR2AC7 remain open. Next research bd-01M21BNZR9ZBRAYY9JD5WCQ8KX evaluates joint effect-and-variance Gaussian bootstrap under declared nuisance/df assumptions. PLS Neuro docs/group-glm-inference-plan.md was updated separately; consumer integration, general F, repeated-subject, spatial and real serial-noise uncertainty qualification remain outstanding. No commit or publication performed.
